title: オフィスでの会話：会議の変更

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Hi Karen, do you have a minute? I need to talk about tomorrow's budget meeting.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Sure. Is there a problem with the schedule?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Actually, yes. Two of the department heads are going to be out of town tomorrow, so I'd like to push the meeting back to Thursday afternoon.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That should work for me. Let me just check the conference room isn't already booked, and I'll send everyone an updated invitation.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Thanks. Could you also print extra copies of the sales report? I think a few more people will join this time.

questions.question: Why does the man want to change the meeting?
choices: The conference room is being renovated.
Some department heads will be away.
The budget report is not finished.
The woman requested a later time.
questions.explanation: 男性は「部長の何人かが明日出張でいない」と述べており、それが会議変更の理由です。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do next?
choices: Check room availability and send a new invitation.
Ask the man to lead the meeting.
questions.explanation: 女性は会議室の空き状況を確認し、新しい招待状を送ると言っています。

questions.question: What does the man ask the woman to do?
choices: Print additional copies of a report.
questions.explanation: 男性は売上報告書の追加コピーの印刷を依頼しています。

title: レストランでの会話：予約の問題

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Hello, this is Table Nine restaurant. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Hi, I made a reservation for eight people tonight at seven, but I need to change it to six-thirty. Is that possible?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Let me check... I'm afraid seven is our only opening around that time on the patio, but we do have an indoor table available at six-thirty.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That's fine, we don't mind sitting inside. Also, one guest has a shellfish allergy — could you let the kitchen know?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Of course, I'll note that on the reservation right away.

questions.question: What does the man want to change?
questions.explanation: 男性は予約時間を7時から6時30分に変更したいと述べています。

questions.question: What does the woman offer the man?
choices: A table on the patio at seven.
questions.explanation: 女性は屋内の席なら6時30分に空きがあると案内しています。

questions.question: What does the man mention about one of his guests?
choices: The guest has a food allergy.
The guest prefers a window seat.
The guest is celebrating a birthday.
questions.explanation: 男性は「甲殻類アレルギーがある」とゲストについて伝えています。

title: 店舗での会話：返品と交換

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Excuse me, I bought this printer last week, but it keeps jamming every time I try to print.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt with you?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Yes, right here. I'd like to exchange it for a different model, if possible.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That won't be a problem since it's within our thirty-day exchange window. Would you like the same model or a different one?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I'll take a different one this time — maybe something a bit more reliable, even if it costs a little more.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Sure, let me show you our top-rated model over in aisle three.

questions.question: What problem does the woman describe?
choices: An item was the wrong color.
questions.explanation: 女性はプリンターが印刷のたびに紙詰まりすると説明しています。

questions.question: What does the man ask the woman for?
questions.explanation: 男性はレシートを持っているか尋ねています。

questions.question: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explanation: 男性は3番通路にある人気モデルを案内すると言っています。

title: 同僚同士の会話：パソコンのトラブル

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Hey, my laptop suddenly froze while I was finishing the quarterly report. Do you know who I should contact?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: You should call the IT help desk — the number's on the intranet page. But it's usually pretty busy on Monday mornings.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I don't want to wait too long; the report is due by noon.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Why don't you use my laptop for now? I finished my part of the report already, and I won't need it for another hour.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That would really help. Thanks — I'll bring it back as soon as I submit the file.

questions.question: What is the man's problem?
choices: His printer ran out of ink.
questions.explanation: 男性はレポート作成中にノートパソコンがフリーズしたと述べています。

questions.question: According to the woman, why might there be a delay?
choices: The IT staff are on vacation.
The help desk is often busy on Mondays.
The office is closed for a holiday.
questions.explanation: 女性は月曜の朝はヘルプデスクが混み合うことが多いと述べています。

questions.question: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.explanation: 女性は自分のノートパソコンをしばらく使っていいと申し出ています。

title: 取引先との電話：配送の遅延

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Hi, this is Lisa from Harborview Supplies. I'm calling about order number four-five-two.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Yes, let me pull that up. I see it was scheduled to ship out yesterday.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's the issue — we still haven't received a shipping confirmation, and our client needs the materials by Friday.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I apologize for the delay. It looks like the item was held up at the warehouse. I can arrange express shipping at no extra charge so it arrives by Thursday.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That would be great. Could you send me the tracking number once it ships?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Absolutely, I'll email it to you within the hour.

questions.question: Why is the woman calling?
choices: To ask about a delayed shipment.
questions.explanation: 女性は出荷確認がまだ届いていないことについて問い合わせています。

questions.question: What does the man offer to do?
choices: Provide express shipping at no extra cost.
questions.explanation: 男性は追加料金なしで速達配送を手配すると申し出ています。

questions.question: What will the man send the woman later?
questions.explanation: 男性は1時間以内に追跡番号をメールすると伝えています。

title: 面接後のフォローアップ電話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Hi, this is David calling from Bright Path Marketing. Is this Ms. Chen?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Yes, speaking. Thank you for calling.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I'm calling to let you know the hiring committee was impressed with your interview last week, and we'd like to invite you for a second interview with our creative director.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's wonderful news! When would that take place?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: We were thinking next Tuesday at ten in the morning. It should last about forty-five minutes, and this time we'd also like you to bring a portfolio of your recent design work.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Tuesday morning works perfectly. I'll have my portfolio ready.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the call?
choices: To invite the woman to a second interview.
To offer the woman a job.
questions.explanation: 男性は2次面接への招待のために電話しています。

questions.question: How long will the second interview last?
questions.explanation: 面接はおよそ45分続く予定だと述べられています。

questions.question: What is the woman asked to bring?
questions.explanation: 最近のデザイン作品のポートフォリオを持参するよう頼まれています。

title: 空港での会話：フライトの遅延

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Excuse me, I just saw that flight two-one-four to Chicago has been delayed. Do you know how long the delay will be?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Let me check for you... it looks like the new departure time is three hours later, due to a mechanical inspection.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Three hours? I have a connecting flight in Chicago that I might miss now.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I understand your concern. I can rebook you on a later connecting flight, or if you prefer, I can look into a different route through Denver that arrives around the same time as your original plan.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: The Denver route sounds better. Could you check availability for me?

questions.question: Why has the flight been delayed?
questions.explanation: 整備点検のため出発が遅れていると説明されています。

questions.question: What is the man worried about?
questions.explanation: 男性は乗り継ぎ便に乗れなくなるかもしれないと心配しています。

questions.question: What does the man decide to do?
choices: Look into a route through Denver.
questions.explanation: 男性はデンバー経由のルートの方が良いと答え、空き状況の確認を頼んでいます。

title: ホテルでのチェックアウト：請求の確認

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Hi, I'm checking out of room three-twelve, but I noticed an extra charge on my bill for room service I never ordered.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I'm sorry about that. Let me take a look at the account... You're right, there's a charge from Tuesday night that doesn't match your other orders.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Right, I was actually out at a client dinner that evening.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I'll remove that charge immediately and print you a corrected receipt. I'll also apply a small discount on your final bill for the inconvenience.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I appreciate that. Could I also get a copy of the receipt sent to my email instead of printed?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Of course, I'll send it to the email address on file right now.

questions.question: What is the woman's complaint?
choices: She was charged for a service she didn't use.
questions.explanation: 女性は注文していないルームサービスの請求があると述べています。

questions.question: What does the man offer the woman?
questions.explanation: 男性はお詫びとして最終請求額から割引を適用すると言っています。

questions.question: What does the woman request instead of a printed receipt?
questions.explanation: 女性は印刷ではなくメールでの領収書送付を希望しています。

title: 留守番電話メッセージ

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Hi, this message is for Mr. Ito. This is Rachel from Prime Office Furniture returning your call about the desk order.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: I checked our warehouse, and unfortunately the model you wanted is currently out of stock, but we expect a new shipment by the end of next week.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: In the meantime, I can offer you a similar desk from a different collection at the same price, if you'd like to see it sooner.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please give me a call back at your convenience so we can discuss which option works best for you. My direct line is five-five-five, oh-one-nine-two.

questions.question: Why is Rachel calling?
choices: To respond to a call about a furniture order.
To apologize for a billing error.
questions.explanation: レイチェルはデスクの注文についての折り返し電話をしています。

questions.question: What problem does Rachel mention?
choices: The desk is out of stock.
questions.explanation: 希望のモデルが現在在庫切れだと伝えています。

questions.question: What does Rachel ask Mr. Ito to do?
questions.explanation: 都合の良いときに折り返し電話をしてほしいと頼んでいます。

title: ラジオ広告：セールのお知らせ

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Are you looking to refresh your home this season? Come visit Maple Street Furnishings for our biggest sale of the year!

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: From this Friday through Sunday, all sofas and dining sets are up to forty percent off, and any purchase over three hundred dollars comes with free delivery.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We're located right next to Central Park Mall, and we're open until nine PM every night during the sale.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Don't miss out — supplies are limited, so stop by early for the best selection.

questions.question: What is being advertised?
questions.explanation: 家具のセールについての広告です。

questions.question: What is included with purchases over three hundred dollars?
choices: A discount coupon for next time.
questions.explanation: 300ドル以上の購入には送料無料が付くと述べられています。

questions.question: According to the advertisement, why should listeners come early?
choices: The store closes early on weekends.
Prices increase after the first day.
questions.explanation: 品数に限りがあるため早めの来店を勧めています。

title: 交通情報レポート

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Good morning, commuters. Here's your traffic update for downtown routes.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Construction on Fifth Avenue continues today, so drivers heading toward the financial district should expect delays of about twenty minutes and consider taking Riverside Drive instead.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The Grant Street Bridge is running smoothly, but expect heavier traffic after eight AM as schools open for the week.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We'll have another update in thirty minutes. Stay safe out there.

questions.question: What is causing delays on Fifth Avenue?
questions.explanation: 5番街の工事が原因で遅延が発生していると述べられています。

questions.question: What alternative route is suggested?
questions.explanation: 代わりにリバーサイドドライブを利用するよう勧めています。

questions.question: When will the next traffic update be given?
questions.explanation: 30分後に次の交通情報を伝えると述べています。

title: 美術館ツアーガイドの案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Welcome to the Riverside Art Museum. My name is Grace, and I'll be your guide for this afternoon's tour.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We'll begin on the second floor with our collection of modern paintings, then move to the sculpture garden before finishing in the gift shop.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please note that photography is allowed in most galleries, but flash photography is not permitted near the older paintings, as it can damage the artwork.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you have any questions along the way, feel free to ask. Let's head to the elevator to get started.

questions.question: Who most likely is Grace?
questions.explanation: グレースはツアーガイドとして自己紹介しています。

questions.question: Where will the tour end?
questions.explanation: ツアーはギフトショップで終わると述べています。

questions.question: What are listeners asked NOT to do?
choices: Use flash photography near old paintings.
questions.explanation: 古い絵画の近くではフラッシュ撮影が禁止されていると案内しています。

title: 社内研修の案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Good afternoon, everyone. I'd like to remind you all about the customer service training session happening this Thursday.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The session will run from one to four in the afternoon in Conference Room B, and it's mandatory for all staff in the sales and support departments.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We'll be covering our new complaint-handling procedures, along with a few updates to the customer database system.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please bring your laptops, since part of the session will involve hands-on practice with the new software.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the announcement?
choices: To remind staff about a training session.
questions.explanation: 木曜日の研修についてのリマインドです。

questions.question: Who is required to attend?
questions.explanation: 営業部とサポート部のスタッフ全員が対象だと述べています。

questions.question: What should attendees bring?
questions.explanation: 新しいソフトウェアの実習があるためノートパソコンの持参を求めています。

title: 空港での搭乗案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Attention passengers, this is the final boarding call for flight three-zero-six to Seattle.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: All remaining passengers should proceed to gate twelve immediately, as the doors will close in ten minutes.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please have your boarding pass and identification ready for the gate agent.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Passengers requiring extra time to board should identify themselves to airline staff at this time.

questions.question: What is the announcement about?
questions.explanation: 最終搭乗案内についてのアナウンスです。

questions.question: What should passengers have ready?
questions.explanation: 搭乗券と身分証明書を用意するよう伝えています。

questions.question: Who is asked to identify themselves to staff?
questions.explanation: 搭乗に追加の時間が必要な乗客はスタッフに申し出るよう案内しています。

title: 新製品発表のプレゼンテーション

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Thank you all for joining us today. I'm excited to introduce our newest product, the EcoBrew coffee maker.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Unlike our previous models, EcoBrew uses forty percent less energy and is made from recycled materials, which fits perfectly with our company's new sustainability goals.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: It will be available in stores starting next month, and we're offering an early-bird discount for customers who preorder this week.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Now, let's take a short break, and when we return, our engineering team will demonstrate how the machine works.

questions.question: What is being introduced?
questions.explanation: 新しいコーヒーメーカー「EcoBrew」の紹介です。

questions.question: What is a feature of the new product?
choices: It brews faster than older models.
It uses less energy and recycled materials.
It comes with a lifetime warranty.
questions.explanation: 従来モデルよりエネルギー消費が少なく、リサイクル素材を使用していると述べています。

questions.question: What will happen after the break?
questions.explanation: 休憩後にエンジニアリングチームが製品のデモを行うと述べています。

title: 新入社員向けオリエンテーション

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Welcome to Bright Horizon Incorporated, and congratulations on joining our team.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This morning, we'll cover the basics — your ID badge, building access, and where to find the employee handbook on our intranet.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: After lunch, each of you will meet individually with your department supervisor to go over your specific responsibilities and set goals for your first month.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you haven't already, please make sure to submit your emergency contact information to Human Resources by the end of the day.

questions.question: Who is the audience for this talk?
questions.explanation: 新しく入社した社員に向けたオリエンテーションです。

questions.question: What will happen after lunch?
questions.explanation: 昼食後、各自の部署の上司と個別に面談すると述べています。

questions.question: What are new employees asked to submit by the end of the day?
questions.explanation: 緊急連絡先の情報を人事部に提出するよう求めています。

title: オフィスでの会話：コピー機の故障

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: The copier on the third floor is jammed again. This is the third time this month.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I know, it's getting old. I already put in a request to replace it, but facilities said it could take a few weeks.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: A few weeks? I have client documents to print for tomorrow's presentation.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: You can use the one in the marketing department for now — I'll let them know you're coming. It's a bit slower, but it's reliable.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That works. Could you also ask facilities to prioritize the replacement given how often it breaks down?

questions.question: What is the problem being discussed?
questions.explanation: 3階のコピー機が紙詰まりを起こしていることが問題として話されています。

questions.question: What does the man say about the replacement?
choices: It could take a few weeks.
questions.explanation: 交換までに数週間かかる可能性があると男性は述べています。

questions.question: What does the man suggest the woman do?
questions.explanation: マーケティング部のコピー機を使うよう提案しています。

title: 出張の準備についての会話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Have you finished booking your flight for the Osaka conference next week?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Not yet. I was waiting to see if the schedule would change, but it looks confirmed now, so I'll book it this afternoon.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Good. Also, don't forget to submit your travel expense form before you leave — accounting needs it at least three days in advance.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Right, I'll take care of that today as well. Do you know if the hotel near the venue still has rooms available?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I checked yesterday and there were a few left, but I'd book soon since it's a popular hotel during conference season.

questions.question: What is the woman planning to do this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 女性は今日の午後にフライトを予約すると述べています。

questions.question: What does the man remind the woman about?
questions.explanation: 出発前に旅費精算書を提出する必要があると伝えています。

questions.question: What does the man say about the hotel?
choices: A few rooms are still available.
It has been changed to a different one.
questions.explanation: まだ数室空きがあるが、人気のため早めの予約を勧めています。

title: 会議室予約の重複についての会話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I think there's a mix-up — I booked the main conference room for two o'clock, but another team is already in there.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Let me check the booking system... it looks like both your reservation and theirs were entered for the same time slot by mistake.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's frustrating. My client is arriving in fifteen minutes, so I really need a room now.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: The small meeting room on the fourth floor is free until four. It's smaller, but it should be fine for a client meeting.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That'll do. Could you update the booking system so this doesn't happen again next time?

questions.question: What is the woman's problem?
questions.explanation: 予約した会議室に既に別のチームがいるという問題です。

questions.question: Why did the mix-up happen?
choices: The woman forgot to reserve a room.
The room was closed for cleaning.
The client changed the meeting time.
questions.explanation: 予約システムで同じ時間帯に二重に登録されていたためです。

questions.question: What does the man suggest?
choices: Using a smaller room on the fourth floor.
questions.explanation: 4階の小会議室が4時まで空いていると提案しています。

title: 新入社員のオンボーディングについての会話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Hi, I'm supposed to start in the accounting department today, but I'm not sure where to go.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Welcome! You must be Daniel. I'm from HR — I'll walk you to your desk and introduce you to your team.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Thank you. Is there anything I need to fill out before I get started?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Yes, just a few forms for your ID badge and direct deposit, which we can finish in about ten minutes. After that, your manager will give you a tour of the office.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Sounds good. I also received a laptop in the mail last week — should I bring it with me every day?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Yes, please do. IT will set it up with your accounts once you're at your desk.

questions.question: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: 女性は自分を人事部の担当者だと紹介しています。

questions.question: What will the man do before the office tour?
questions.explanation: IDバッジや口座振替の書類記入を先に済ませると述べられています。

questions.question: What does the woman say about the man's laptop?
choices: He should return it to IT.
He should bring it every day.
It is not needed at work.
questions.explanation: 毎日持参するよう伝え、IT部門が設定を行うと説明しています。

title: 展示会の準備についての会話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: How is the preparation for next month's trade show going? Have the banners arrived yet?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: The banners came in yesterday, but the printing company made an error — the company logo is slightly cut off on two of them.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's not good. Can we get them reprinted in time for the show?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I already contacted the printer, and they agreed to redo them at no extra cost. They said the corrected banners will arrive by next Wednesday.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's a relief. Let's also double-check the booth layout before then so we're not fixing two things at once.

questions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
questions.explanation: 来月の展示会の準備について話しています。

questions.question: What problem does the man describe?
choices: The banners have a printing error.
The printer went out of business.
questions.explanation: ロゴが一部切れてしまう印刷ミスがあったと述べています。

questions.question: When will the corrected banners arrive?
questions.explanation: 修正されたバナーは来週水曜日までに届くと述べられています。

title: 顧客からの製品に関する問い合わせ電話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Hello, I recently purchased one of your blenders, and I'm having trouble finding a replacement part for it.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I'd be happy to help. Could you tell me the model number? It should be printed on the bottom of the base.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: It's model BX-220. I'm looking for a replacement blade, since mine cracked after a few months of use.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That model is still under warranty for one year, so we can send you a free replacement blade. I just need your order number to process it.

script.speaker: Woman

script.line: Did you see the draft of the new company logo? Marketing shared it in this morning's meeting.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I did. I like the color scheme, but I think the font might be hard to read on smaller screens.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That's a fair point. I'll bring it up when we give feedback tomorrow — they're collecting comments until Friday.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Good, because once it's finalized, it'll be used on everything from business cards to the website.

questions.question: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation: 新しい会社ロゴについて話しています。

questions.question: What concern does the woman raise?
choices: The font may be hard to read on small screens.
The logo is too similar to a competitor's.
The logo is too expensive to produce.
questions.explanation: 小さい画面ではフォントが読みにくいかもしれないと指摘しています。

questions.question: Until when is feedback being collected?
questions.explanation: 金曜日までフィードバックを募集していると述べています。

title: 顧客からのオンライン注文トラブルについての電話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Hi, I placed an order online yesterday, but I just noticed I selected the wrong shipping address.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Let me look that up. Since the order hasn't shipped yet, I should be able to update the address for you right now.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That's a relief. Could you also confirm the new estimated delivery date once it's updated?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Of course — with the corrected address, it looks like it will now arrive on Thursday instead of Wednesday.

questions.question: Why is the woman calling?
choices: To fix a shipping address error.
To ask about a discount code.
questions.explanation: 配送先住所の入力ミスを修正するために電話しています。

questions.question: Why can the man make the change easily?
choices: The woman is a premium member.
The item is out of stock anyway.
questions.explanation: まだ発送されていないため変更が可能だと説明しています。

questions.question: What is the new estimated delivery date?
questions.explanation: 住所修正後は木曜日に届く予定だと伝えています。

title: 会社の駐輪場ルールについての会話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I noticed a new sign at the bike rack saying we need to register our bicycles now. Do you know why?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Yes, there were a couple of bikes stolen last month, so building management wants a record of who parks there.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That makes sense. How do we register?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: You just need to fill out a short form at the security desk with your bike's color and serial number.

questions.question: What changed at the bike rack?
choices: It was moved to a new location.
questions.explanation: 駐輪登録が必要になったと話しています。

questions.question: Why was this change made?
choices: For a new company policy on parking fees.
questions.explanation: 先月自転車の盗難があったためだと説明しています。

questions.question: How does one register a bicycle?
choices: By filling out a form at the security desk.
questions.explanation: 警備デスクで簡単な用紙に記入すると説明しています。

title: 会議の議事録作成についての会話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Could you send me the notes from yesterday's strategy meeting? I had to leave early and missed the second half.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Sure, I took pretty detailed notes. I'll clean them up and send them to you by this afternoon.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Thanks. Did the team decide on a launch date for the new campaign?

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Yes, they settled on the fifteenth of next month, but I'll include all the details in the notes.

questions.question: What does the woman ask for?
questions.explanation: 昨日の会議のメモを頼んでいます。

questions.question: Why does the woman need the notes?
choices: She wasn't invited to the meeting.
questions.explanation: 会議の途中で退席したためだと述べています。

questions.question: What did the team decide?
choices: A launch date for the campaign.
questions.explanation: 新キャンペーンの開始日を決定したと述べています。

title: 取引先訪問前の準備についての会話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Are we ready for the client visit tomorrow? I want to make sure the meeting room is set up properly.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I already reserved the room and ordered coffee and snacks for ten people, as you asked.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Great. Could you also print extra copies of the proposal in case they bring more people than expected?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I'll print five extra copies just to be safe, along with the updated pricing sheet.

questions.question: What is being prepared for?
questions.explanation: 翌日の取引先訪問の準備をしています。

questions.question: What has the woman already arranged?
questions.explanation: 会議室の予約と飲食物の手配を済ませています。

questions.question: What extra item does the man request?
questions.explanation: 提案書の予備を印刷するよう頼んでいます。

title: 顧客アンケート結果についての会話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I finished reviewing the customer survey results. Overall satisfaction is up, but several people mentioned slow response times from support.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: That matches what I've been hearing. Do you think we need to hire more support staff?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: Possibly, but first I'd like to see if better training or a new ticketing system could solve the issue.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Let's present both options to management next week and let them decide on the budget.

questions.question: What did the survey reveal?
choices: Satisfaction is up, but support is slow.
questions.explanation: 満足度は上がったがサポートの応答が遅いという結果でした。

questions.question: What does the woman want to try first?
choices: Better training or a new ticketing system.
questions.explanation: まずトレーニングや新しいシステムを試したいと述べています。

questions.question: What will happen next week?
choices: Options will be presented to management.
The support department will be closed.
questions.explanation: 来週、管理職に選択肢を提示すると述べています。

title: オフィスの植物の手入れについての会話

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Who's been watering the plants in the break room lately? A few of them look like they're wilting.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: I think it used to be Sarah's job, but she moved to a different floor last month, so maybe no one picked it up.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: I can water them twice a week if someone shows me which ones need more sunlight.

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: That would be great. I'll send you a quick guide I found on caring for office plants.

questions.question: What problem is being discussed?
questions.explanation: 休憩室の植物がしおれているという問題です。

questions.question: Why might the plants have been neglected?
choices: The person responsible moved to another floor.
The office ran out of water.
questions.explanation: 担当していたサラが別のフロアに異動したためだと説明しています。

questions.question: What does the man offer to do?
choices: Water the plants twice a week.
questions.explanation: 週に2回水やりをすると申し出ています。

title: 地域イベントへの協賛についての会話

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: The local community center asked if our company would like to sponsor their summer festival again this year.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: We sponsored it last year, right? How did that go over with the marketing team?

script.speaker: Woman
script.line: It went well — it got us some good local press. I think we should do it again, maybe with a bigger booth this time.

script.speaker: Man
script.line: Let's put together a proposal with the cost estimate and send it to the director for approval by next week.

questions.question: What is the community center asking about?
questions.explanation: 夏祭りへの協賛について依頼していると述べています。

questions.question: How did last year's sponsorship go?
questions.explanation: 地元メディアで好意的に取り上げられたと述べています。

questions.question: What will the speakers do next?
choices: Prepare a proposal for the director.
questions.explanation: コスト見積もりを添えた提案書を作成すると述べています。

title: 店舗の営業時間変更のお知らせ

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please note that starting next Monday, our store hours will change slightly.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We will now open one hour earlier, at eight in the morning, but close one hour earlier as well, at seven in the evening.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This change is based on customer feedback requesting earlier access before work hours.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Weekend hours will remain the same. Thank you for shopping with us.

questions.question: What is changing next Monday?
questions.explanation: 来週月曜から営業時間が変更されると案内しています。

questions.question: What time will the store now open?
questions.explanation: 朝8時に開店するようになると述べています。

questions.question: Why was this change made?
questions.explanation: 顧客からの要望を受けての変更だと説明しています。

title: 求人説明会の案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Thank you all for coming to today's recruitment information session.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We'll begin with a short presentation about our company culture and available positions, followed by a chance to speak one-on-one with hiring managers from different departments.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you're interested in applying, please bring your resume to the tables set up near the entrance after the presentation.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We'll also be holding a raffle at the end, so make sure to sign in at the front desk to be eligible.

questions.question: What is this event?
questions.explanation: 求人説明会についての案内です。

questions.question: What will happen after the presentation?
questions.explanation: 各部署の採用担当者との個別面談があると述べています。

questions.question: What should attendees do to enter the raffle?
choices: Sign in at the front desk.
questions.explanation: 受付で記帳することが応募条件だと述べています。

title: 健康診断の案内放送

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This is a reminder that this year's on-site health checkup will take place next Tuesday and Wednesday in the third-floor conference room.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Employees should arrive during their scheduled time slot, which was sent by email last week, and should not eat for at least eight hours beforehand.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Please bring your employee ID and a valid form of identification.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you haven't received a time slot or need to reschedule, please contact the HR office before Friday.

questions.question: Where will the checkup take place?
questions.explanation: 3階の会議室で行われると案内しています。

questions.question: What are employees asked to do before the checkup?
choices: Not eat for at least eight hours.
questions.explanation: 8時間以上絶食するよう求めています。

questions.question: What should employees do if they need to reschedule?
choices: Just show up on a different day.
questions.explanation: 金曜日までに人事部に連絡するよう案内しています。

title: 図書館の閉館時間変更案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Attention library visitors, please note a temporary change to our closing time this month.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Due to staff training sessions, the library will now close at six in the evening instead of the usual nine, every Wednesday this month.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: All other days will keep their regular hours, and the book return box outside will remain available at all times.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

questions.question: What is changing this month?
questions.explanation: 水曜日の閉館時間が変更されると案内しています。

questions.question: Why is the change happening?
questions.explanation: スタッフの研修のためだと説明しています。

questions.question: What remains available at all times?
questions.explanation: 屋外の返却ボックスは常時利用可能だと述べています。

title: 電話システムメンテナンスの通知

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This is a notice regarding scheduled maintenance to our phone system this weekend.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Starting Saturday at midnight, phone lines will be unavailable for approximately six hours while we upgrade our network equipment.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: During this time, customers can still reach us through our website's live chat feature or by sending an email, and we'll respond as soon as the system is back online.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We expect normal phone service to resume by six in the morning on Sunday.

questions.question: What is happening this weekend?
questions.explanation: 電話システムのメンテナンスが行われると案内しています。

questions.question: How long will the phone lines be down?
questions.explanation: 約6時間電話が利用できなくなると述べています。

questions.question: What alternative contact methods are mentioned?
questions.explanation: ライブチャットとメールで対応可能だと案内しています。

title: 展示会ブースでの製品説明

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Thank you for stopping by our booth. Let me quickly show you our newest fitness tracker, the FitPulse Two.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Unlike our previous model, it tracks sleep quality in addition to heart rate and steps, and the battery lasts up to ten days on a single charge.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: It will be available in stores starting next month, but everyone who signs up at our booth today will receive an exclusive early-access discount.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you're interested, please leave your email at the sign-up sheet on the table beside me.

questions.question: What product is being introduced?
questions.explanation: 新しいフィットネストラッカーの紹介です。

questions.question: What new feature does this model have?
questions.explanation: 睡眠の質を計測できる点が新機能だと述べています。

questions.question: How can visitors get an early-access discount?
choices: Sign up with their email at the booth.
Follow the company on social media.
questions.explanation: サインアップシートにメールアドレスを記入することで割引を受けられると説明しています。

title: 駐車場の一時閉鎖案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This is an announcement regarding the east parking lot.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The lot will be closed this Thursday and Friday for repaving, so employees who normally park there should use the west lot or the street parking on Grant Avenue instead.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Shuttle service between the west lot and the main building will run every fifteen minutes during business hours.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We apologize for the temporary inconvenience and expect the east lot to reopen Monday morning.

questions.question: Why is the east parking lot closing?
questions.explanation: 舗装工事のため閉鎖されると案内しています。

questions.question: What are affected employees advised to do?
choices: Use the west lot or street parking.
questions.explanation: 西側駐車場か通りの駐車を利用するよう案内しています。

questions.question: How often will the shuttle run?
questions.explanation: 15分ごとにシャトルが運行すると述べています。

title: オンラインセミナー開始前の案内

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Welcome, everyone, to today's session on effective time management.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Before we begin, please make sure your microphone is muted unless you're asking a question, and feel free to use the chat box for comments throughout.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This session will last about fifty minutes, and a recording will be sent to all registered participants by tomorrow afternoon.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Let's get started with our first topic: prioritizing daily tasks.

questions.question: What is the topic of the session?
questions.explanation: 効果的な時間管理についてのセミナーです。

questions.question: What are participants asked to do with their microphones?
choices: Keep them on at all times.
Mute them unless asking a question.
questions.explanation: 質問時以外はミュートにするよう案内しています。

questions.question: What will be sent to participants tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 録画を翌日の午後までに送ると述べています。
